mutations.name: PREDICTED KILLED (1 red) - the pinned-set gate goes, so the closure publishes a probe for an id its credential holds no rail for: the request the broker must refuse, sent anyway
mutations.expectRed: and NOTHING left the connection for it
mutations.cell: and NOTHING left the connection for it

mutations.name: PREDICTED KILLED (>=1 red) - a refused probe stops settling, so the gather waits out the broker's refusal as if it were an instance thinking about it, which is the invisible failure this whole layer exists to prevent
mutations.expectRed: and the row says the probe was REFUSED, distinct from an instance that stayed silent
mutations.cell: and the row says the probe was REFUSED, distinct from an instance that stayed silent

mutations.name: PREDICTED KILLED (1 red) - the refusal is no longer announced, so an operator sees a slow command and no reason for it
mutations.find: report(`! the broker refused this command's liveness probe for manager instance ${id}: ${err.message}`);
mutations.expectRed: the broker's refusal is REPORTED, not left to expire into silence
mutations.cell: the broker's refusal is REPORTED, not left to expire into silence

mutations.name: PREDICTED KILLED (1 red) - a refused probe reports as an ordinary silent instance, so the row blames the instance for the credential's gap
mutations.expectRed: and the row says the probe was REFUSED, distinct from an instance that stayed silent
mutations.cell: and the row says the probe was REFUSED, distinct from an instance that stayed silent

mutations.name: PREDICTED KILLED (>=2 red) - attribution goes back to matching an id ANYWHERE in the refused subject, so one broker refusal is charged to every frozen id that is a prefix of the refused one and that instance's row reads probe-refused on another rail's evidence
mutations.expectRed: the refusal of the LONGER id produces exactly ONE violation line, not one per id inside it
mutations.cell: the refusal of the LONGER id produces exactly ONE violation line, not one per id inside it

mutations.name: PREDICTED KILLED (>=1 red) - an id that was never handed to the hook reports as an ordinary silent instance rather than as un-asked, so a fact about the command is printed as a fact about the instance
mutations.expectRed: and one outside the set reads NOT-PROBED without the hook ever running
mutations.cell: and one outside the set reads NOT-PROBED without the hook ever running

_note: The suite imports `@cotal-ai/workspace/control`, which resolves to dist, so each mutation builds workspace first and rebuilds it after the restore. No mutation here touches core. Mutation 1 deletes the gate rather than inverting it so that the pinned path is untouched: the point is what leaves the connection for an UNPINNED id, and section 3's counter cell stays green to show the instrument still works.
